note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample of named events (only 9 of more than 70 boat strikes are logged one by one) and nothing is logged after Oct 27, 2026.
headline: Talks with the interim government moved up a level: on Nov 2 Rubio met new Foreign Minister Oliver Blanco, the first such meeting since Maduro's capture, and Treasury Secretary Bessent met him on the economy; the NYT reports the US is also negotiating an agreement that could let US troops stay (#4070).

Venezuela's army struck a Colombian ELN rebel camp in Apure on Oct 30-31, killing at least 19-23; US officials told the NYT it used US intelligence and drones (#4069). This was cooperation against an armed group, not a hostile act toward the US.

No new US boat strike was found after the Oct 27 strike that killed five (#4067), and no Venezuelan hostile reply to it was found in its 7-day window. SOUTHCOM's own press page could not be opened, so a strike announced only there could be missing.
The Maduro case passed to Judge Analisa Torres after Judge Hellerstein's death; she kept the June trial date (#4068).
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases, and options F and G are too thin to measure.
pending: Whether the talks lead to an election date, a status of forces agreement or more sanctions relief (#4070)
Whether the US keeps striking boats while it deals with the interim government (#4064, #4067)
Next steps in the Maduro case under Judge Torres (#4068)
